verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai/openapi.json, an llms.txt index and a quickstart that sends a prompt and gets a response. None of it documents an interactive API reference or explorer where examples can be run in the docs. A machine-readable spec and a quickstart are building blocks for such a reference, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
